note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it shipped; tools/qa-cover-recipes.mjs renders it again and fails when median d or the moving share move more than 15 %, seamLocal leaves the cover TARGET, the file passes 2 MiB or the render exits non-zero. Measured 2026-10-20 on headless Chrome's software rung with CPU raster and libwebp 1.6.0.

treatment.request: Make a looping README cover for LitOpenCode that shows a running system.
treatment.idea: Three orbits cross one gate and every crossing lights a cell of the ledger under the name.
treatment.recipeReason: A system with whole-number laps closes by itself and gives the beat events a cause.
treatment.beat: Each crossing at the gate lights the next ledger cell.

layers.slow: Dashed guide rings turn one dash period per loop.
layers.mid: Three dots lap their rings three, two and one times.
layers.beat: The gate flashes and a ledger cell lights at each crossing; the core rings on four bars.

system.rule: One orbit law, angle from laps and direction.
system.offset: Each ring's start angle and direction.

treatment.ambition: Every beat event has a visible cause, and the crossings are solved rather than detected.
